responsibility: Implements a reduced view of an exploded_graph containing only nodes and edges that can reach a chosen destination node. Starting from a diagnostic endpoint, this file walks predecessors to collect the reachable subset, wraps the retained exploded nodes and edges in trimmed_graph nodes and edges, preserves deterministic ordering by iterating the original graph vectors, and delegates dot rendering back to the underlying exploded-graph objects for focused diagnostic and debugging visualizations.
same_name_distinction: Implements construction of the trimmed_graph view declared in trimmed-graph.h by walking predecessors from a chosen exploded-graph destination, selecting the retained node/edge subset, and delegating dot output to the wrapped exploded-graph objects; the header mainly defines the wrapper graph types and membership API.
